root_cause.summary: loop_health and loop_health_detail passed the authorized trading stage (paper) to LoopControllerStore.list_records, but controller records are keyed by the deployment environment every LoopControllerWriter records (PANTHEON_ENV, dev on the dev VM). /bff/v5/loop-health therefore never returned a controller record for any of the twelve loops.
root_cause.introduced_by: #6287 BFF-LOOP-TRUTH-STAGE-SCOPE-20261007 (merged 2026-10-07 12:45Z): correct stage-scoped authorization, but its shared scope also became the controller-store lookup key; before it loop_health defaulted to the deployment name.
root_cause.detected_by: Isolated runtime suite on a local merge of #6337 and #6339: L8-L11 evidence and the downstream-health wait passed, then the bff_health_monitoring loop-health row never reflected the stopped reconciler.
root_cause.writer_environment_source: All ten writer sites resolve to PANTHEON_ENV (state.environment is set from os.getenv('PANTHEON_ENV') or 'dev' in source_ingestion/controller_worker.py:1581 and research/alpha_replication/replication_controller.py:326).

change.services/control-plane/bff/control_loops: loop_health and loop_health_detail keep authenticated_loop_truth_scope (trading stage) for authorization and query the controller store with self.deployed_environment; meta.scope adds controller_environment.
change.tests: New test_loop_health_reads_controller_records_on_the_deployment_environment. MockLoopTruth asserted environment == 'paper', which encoded the regression; it now asserts the deployment environment. Exact meta.scope assertions in tests/test_control_loops_router.py and test_loop_health_read_model_contract.py add controller_environment and state the post-#6287 stage. No controller writer changed.
